purpose: Exact candidate source/assets allowlist. Null is pending generation, never a successful hash. Export refuses null/missing/changed inputs; refresh hashes only for these already enumerated exact paths.
generatedOutputPolicy: Typed placeholders describe explicit dynamic inputs, never source discovery. release-files.json measures all concrete static source/artifact targets including release-manifest.json; excludes itself and generated release-lock.json/RELEASE-STATUS.json. These two acyclic governance outputs have separately returned SHA256 identities and never attest runtime or legal readiness.
externalPrerequisites: Selected OS must be validated with the actual explicit CLI/worker binaries; exporter does not execute them.
Rust toolchain/target from rust-toolchain.toml and OS linker/SDK must be supplied to build. Cargo.lock is not an offline source archive.

No user cache/environment/config scan or source fetch. Optional explicit cargo-vendor only stores verified extracted bytes, without implicit .cargo/config; offline source-override builds remain NOT_VALIDATED.
Node/TypeScript 5.9.3 are development prerequisites for form rebuilding; exact built browser assets are allowlisted for local serving, browser acceptance remains separate.
Python 3.11+ standard library runs exporter/services/conformance; optional validate_design requires exact requirements-design.txt packages not bundled by this export.
ffmpeg/ffprobe are external explicitly configured developer ProbeTools, not SDK-default/PATH discovered runtimes or bundled payload.

Standalone full-candidate export does not establish product adoption. The application preview supports scoped workflow package installation; see DEVELOPER-PREVIEW.zh-CN.md. No production database, credentials or implicit trust is included.
